headline: Enclosed Space Entry: One Mistake Can Be Fatal
subheadline: No permit. No test. No entry.
insight: Low oxygen and toxic gas give no warning. Test the atmosphere from outside, keep an attendant at the entrance and have rescue gear ready before anyone goes in.

sources.title: Revised recommendations for entering enclosed spaces aboard ships, resolution A.1050(27)

meta.description: Enclosed spaces can hold an atmosphere that cannot support life, with no warning to the senses. The precautions every seafarer must follow before entry.
meta.question: What is the one step you never let anyone skip before entry?
meta.altText: Maritime safety graphic: enclosed space entry requires a permit, atmosphere testing and rescue readiness.
